headline: I'm not ignoring you. You just sent five texts in thirty seconds and hit my personal RATE LIMIT. Please retry in an hour.
caption:
I'm not ignoring you. You just sent five texts in thirty seconds and hit my personal RATE LIMIT. Please retry in an hour.

—
RATE LIMIT: too many requests too fast, so further ones are refused.
